levels.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing
levels.description: The maximum number of Gradient Beacons Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection additionally creates 1 Gradient Beacon. While the Detection Core is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%. Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a Gradient Beacon is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

levels.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness
levels.description: While the Detection Core is present, all opponents within the Polestar Field have their Cryo RES and Electro RES decreased by 20%. Additionally, if the Detection Core created is: Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery; Overloaded: Your active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.

levels.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology
levels.description: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: The Isotopes Born of Decay
levels.description: Detection Cores created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 Gradient Beacons consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

levels.name: The Periodic Law That Orders All
levels.description: Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Chain Reaction by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Elemental Transition at the Gate of Reason
levels.description: Detection Core is enhanced. If the Detection Core: Is in the Steady State: Detection Core deals 115% of its original DMG. Is Overloaded: There is a 34% chance to create 1 new Gradient Beacon whenever Mitya consumes a Gradient Beacon with the Detection Core. Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is Elevated by 20%.
